title: TenantGroupPractitionerLocation
description: Represents the association of a practitioner details at a specific location within a tenant group, including role, availability, and effective dates.

suppressSiteFromDirectory.description: Indicates if the site should be suppressed from the directory.

active.description: Indicates if the record is currently active.

terminationDate.description: The date when the association was terminated.

billingEffectiveDate.description: The effective date for billing purposes.

billingTerminationDate.description: The termination date for billing purposes.

effectiveStartDate.description: The start date when this record becomes effective.

effectiveEndDate.description: The end date when this record is no longer effective.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this is the primary location for the practitioner.

practitionerRolesMap.description: Map of practitioner role key to effective/termination dates.

effectiveDate.description: The effective date for the role.

terminationDate.description: The termination date for the role.

practitionerRoles.description: The roles of the practitioner at this location.

status.description: The status of the practitioner at this location.

roleType.description: The role type of the practitioner at this location.

panelStatus.description: The current panel status for the practitioner at this location.

acceptingNewPatients.description: Indicates if the practitioner is accepting new patients at this location.

medicare.description: Medicare ID for the practitioner at this location.

npi.description: National Provider Identifier for the group practice location.

effectiveDate.description: The effective date for the practitioner location.

changeEffectiveDate.description: The change effective date for the practitioner location.

locationType.description: Type of group location (PRI = Primary, PRA = Practice).

genderAccepted.description: Gender accepted at the practitioner location.

acceptingMinimumPatientAge.description: Minimum patient age accepted at this location.

acceptingMaximumPatientAge.description: Maximum patient age accepted at this location.

minimumEnrolleesCapacity.description: Minimum enrollees capacity for this location.

maximumEnrolleesCapacity.description: Maximum enrollees capacity for this location.

practiceEmail.description: Practice email for the practitioner location.

handicapAccessible.description: Indicates if the location is handicap accessible.

includeLocationInDirectory.description: Indicates if the practitioner location should be included in the directory.

locationTerminationReason.description: Reason provided during termination of a practitioner from location.

practitionerFax.description: Practitioner-specific fax number for this location.

contacts.description: Contact information for the group practice location.

appointment.description: Appointment phone number for the location.

officeHours.description: Office hours for each day of the week.

isClosed.description: Indicates if the location is closed on this day.

practiceLimitation.description: Practice limitations for the practitioner location.

isPrimary.description: Indicates if this is the primary practice limitation.
